content.title: About
content.content: Pudding from dry mix (487) is a quick‑ready dessert that prepares in minutes by adding milk or water. It comes in several non‑chocolate flavors such as vanilla, caramel, strawberry and banana. The mix contains starch, sugar, flavorings and stabilizers, delivering a smooth, creamy texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Dry mixes allow pudding preparation without eggs.
Vanilla flavor is often enriched with natural extracts rather than artificial aromatics.
Caramel version may contain a small amount of butter for a richer taste.
Strawberry pudding is frequently colored with natural berry juice or powder.
Banana flavor is achieved using dried banana flakes.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Sugar and starch provide quick glucose, making it a convenient snack.

items.title: Calcium
items.content: Some variants are fortified with calcium, supporting bone health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 help carbohydrate metabolism.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Egg‑free and dairy‑free preparation (when using plant milk) suits people with mild lactose intolerance.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Preparing with a generous amount of liquid contributes to fluid intake.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Dry mixes often contain high sugar levels, which may be unsuitable for diabetics or those watching weight.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Ingredients may include milk, soy or nuts; check the label if you have allergies.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: A serving can be calorie‑rich due to added sugars and fats.

items.title: Artificial additives
items.content: Some flavors use artificial aromas and colorants that could trigger reactions in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour hot milk, water or a plant‑based drink over the mix, stir thoroughly and let stand 2–3 minutes until thickened. Serve as a standalone dessert, top with fresh berries, nuts, honey or a sprinkle of cinnamon.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. After opening, use within 3–4 months. Discard if it develops off‑odors or changes color.
